notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
You can press on your keyboard F1 to F12 for directly access those levels.
F1 = Easter Island dive.
F2 = Pirates shipwreck dive.
F3 = Lake Mitch dive.
F4 = The Swamp dive.
F5 = The Dump dive.
F6 = The Coral dive.
F7 = Piranha cave dive.
F8 = Lost Roman City dive.
F9 = Lost Temple dive.
F10 = The Deep dive.
F11 = Bermuda Triangle dive.
F12 = WW2 Wreck dive.

New radar on the metal detector to locate the lost treasures.

To teleport: Touch the left touchpad of your controller to aim and press to teleport.
